text:
maria: quick syncwe hit a UAF in staging during a kvcache hotswap. runtime had pointer while allocator freed after demote. crash.

josh: logs?

maria:
[2026-03-22T18:42:12Z] runtime: lock range 0x7ff..0x8ff
[2026-03-22T18:42:12Z] allocator: demote range -> staging
[2026-03-22T18:42:12Z] runtime: spawn async decode using pointer
[2026-03-22T18:42:12Z] allocator: free staging range
[2026-03-22T18:42:12Z] runtime: decode reads freed memory -> crash

anika: proposal: add Allocator::observe(range)->Token + drop(token) to decrement observers. allocator defers free while observers>0.

devon: risk is leaked tokens blocking reuse. need TTL + leak detector + forced-copy fallback.

josh: alternative: epoch grace windows. simpler caller but bulk delays and tail spikes.

taylor: hotswap needs transfer semantics: either transfer tokens or block transfer until observers==0. block hurts availability.

devon: hybrid: source marks TRANSFERRING, new allocator creates proxy entry; transfer completes when observers drop. fallback: force-copy if observer TTL exceeds threshold.

anika: i'll write a short RFC, implement observe API in kvcache/prefetch/decode, add metrics (observer hold-time, forced-copy rate), debug CLI, and unit tests simulating leaks.

maria: agreed plan: tokens + transfer-proxy initial rollout, heavy instrumentation, forced-copy fallback. anika owns RFC.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary hotswap-safety experiment at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z :rocket:
